18411. Ten years ago A was half of B in age. If the ratio of their present age is 3 : 4, what will be the total of their present age -
questions.explain:
Let,
A's age 10 year ago = x year. 
B's age 10 year ago = 2x year.

(x + 10) / (2x+ 10) = 3/4
=> x = 5

So, the total of their present ages
= (x + 10 + 2x + 10)
= (3x + 20)
= 35 year.

questions.question: 18410. The difference of the areas of two squares drawn on two line segments in 32 sq. cm. Find the length of the greater line segment if one is longer than the other by 2 cm.
questions.explain:
Let the lengths of the line segments be x and x+2 cm
then, (x+2)2 − x2 = 32
x2 + 4x + 4 − x2 = 32
4x = 28
x = 7cm
Hence, the greater line should be, x + 2 = 9

questions.question: 18408. On what date is the judiciary separated from the executive branch?
questions.explain:

On this basis, on November 1, 2007, the judiciary was separated from the executive branch. On this day, the journey of independent judiciary started with the implementation of the revised criminal procedure. However, this process has not yet been completed. At present, the Judicial Service Council looks after the appointment and control of judges in the lower courts.

18388. Two alarm clocks ring their alarms at regular intervals of 50 seconds and 48 seconds. If they first beep together at 12 noon, at what time will they beep again for first time?
questions.explain:
They will ring together after, LCM of 48 and 50 secs.
48 = 2 × 2 × 2 × 2 × 3;
50 = 2 × 5 × 5
LCM = 2 × 2 × 2 × 2 × 3 × 5 × 5
= 1200 secs
= 20 min.
They will beep together at 12:20

questions.question: 18386. Two trains moving in same direction at a speed of 60 km/hr and 40 km/hr respectively. If a man sitting in the slower train is passed by the faster train by 10 seconds, then what is the length of the faster train?
questions.explain:
Given:
Speed of slower train = 60 km/hr
Speed of faster train = 40 km/hr
Here both the trains move in same direction.
Hence their relative speed is obtained by subtracting the individual speeds of trains.

Relative speed = 60 – 40 = 20 km/hr

1) Convert km/hr into m/s
20 x (5/18) = 100/18 = 5.56 m/s

2) Distance (Length of faster train)
= Speed x Time Length of faster train
= 5.56 x 10 m = 55.6 m

questions.question: 18371. A 300 meter long train crosses a platform in 39 seconds while it crosses a signal pole in 18 seconds. What is the length of the platform?

or, 3(x+300) = 1950

বাংলা অব্যয় শব্দঃ আর, আবার, ও, হ্যাঁ, না ইত্যাদি।
তৎসম অব্যয় শব্দঃ যদি, যথা, সদা, সহসা, হঠাৎ, অর্থাৎ, দৈবাৎ, বরং, পুনশ্চ, আপাতত, বস্তুত ইত্যাদি।
বিদেশী অব্যয় শব্দঃ আলবত, বহুত, খুব, শাবাশ, খাসা, মাইরি, মারহাবা ইত্যাদি।
[সূত্র: বাংলা ভাষার ব্যাকরণ, ৯ম-১০ম শ্রেণী]
